newsitem.title: USA: Iowa-S Minn fed cattle market not well tested - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Iowa-S Minn fed cattle market not well tested - USDA.

text.p: Slaughter steers and heifers were not tested, compared with Thursday's close, USDA said.. Trade was slow, demand mostly light and seller interest light.
